title: Coordenador de Instalações
description:
Nós acreditamos na capacidade de transformar a sociedade através da inovação e da sustentabilidade. Por isso, nosso principal objetivo é contar com uma equipe motivada e inovadora, que atue em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor, visando sempre a excelência em nossas entregas.

Se você tem desejo de transformar e acredita que pode agregar valor a desafios que envolvem responsabilidade social e ambiental, a Engemon é o lugar ideal

Seus desafios serão:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar sistemas HVAC (ar-condicionado, ventilação e exaustão) e outros sistemas mecânicos.
  • Dimensionar equipamentos como chillers, VRF, ventiladores, dutos, casas de máquinas e componentes associados.
  • Especificar, acompanhar e validar a instalação de tubulações e conexões utilizando sistema grooved (Victaulic ou similar).
  • Realizar análises de risco e desenvolver soluções que garantam segurança operacional e eficiência energética.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (elétrica, civil, automação e segurança do trabalho) para otimização dos projetos.
  • Executar e acompanhar ensaios de aceitação, comissionamento, start-up e manutenção preventiva dos sistemas HVAC.
  • Monitorar e integrar novas tecnologias, tendências e boas práticas do setor mecânico e de climatização.
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos, memoriais, pareceres e documentação para atender normas e exigências regulamentares (ASHRAE, ABNT, SMACNA etc.).
  • Acompanhar e elaborar procedimentos das atividades de campo.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o planejamento e cronograma das instalações.
  • Evidenciar avanço físico de instalação e manutenção de sistemas mecânicos e HVAC.
  • Realizar dimensionamento e gestão de equipes nas atividades de instalação e manutenção.

Valorizado:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos, instalação e manutenção de sistemas HVAC e tubulações industriais.
  • Conhecimento técnico em:
  • Sistemas de climatização central e VRF;
  • Instalação com sistema grooved;
  • Interpretação de projetos, isométricos e diagramas mecânicos;
  • Montagem de casas de máquinas, dutos e tubulações;
  • Acompanhamento e realização de testes de estanqueidade, balanceamento e comissionamento.
  • Conhecimento das normas aplicáveis (ABNT, ASHRAE, SMACNA, NFPA).
  • Habilidade em resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Comunicação eficaz para estabelecer um relacionamento sólido com clientes e equipes.
  • Trabalho em equipe para fomentar um ambiente amigável e colaborativo.
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas demandas de forma eficiente.
  • Dinamismo e flexibilidade para lidar com variados desafios.

Porque trabalhar na Engemon:

Trabalhar na Engemon significa integrar uma empresa com uma história rica, enfrentar uma diversidade de projetos estimulantes, ter oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, fazer parte de uma cultura organizacional que preza pela colaboração, saúde e bem-estar, e contribuir para projetos que geram impactos reais e positivos.

Além disso, você estará em um ambiente que valoriza a tecnologia, a inovação contínua e o protagonismo técnico.

O que oferecemos para você:

Saúde e bem-estar: assistência médica, odontológica, seguro de vida e TotalPass.

Reconhecimento: plano de carreira competitivo para apoiar seu crescimento profissional.

Autonomia: vale-refeição com flexibilidade de uso em diversos estabelecimentos.

Sua operação abrange diversas linhas de negócio como Supermercados, Melhoramento do Lar, Lojas de Departamento, Shopping Centers e Serviços Financeiros. Adicionalmente, desenvolve outras linhas de negócio que complementam sua operação central como Cencosud Media, Cencosud Ventures e CencoPay. Todas se destacam por sua qualidade, excelente nível de serviço e satisfação do cliente.

No Brasil, a Cencosud opera desde 2007, por meio das redes GBarbosa, Mercantil Atacado, Bretas, Perini, Prezunic, SPID, GIGA Atacado, além dos negócios de Serviços Financeiros e retail media, a CencoMedia. Com mais de 300 unidades e cerca de 20 mil colaboradores, o grupo está presente nos estados de Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Pernambuco, Rio de Janeiro, Sergipe e São Paulo, onde também possui um escritório administrativo.

title: Associate Risk Consultant
description:
The Associate Risk Consultant will work a 40-hour work week. This will typically be regular hours (M-F 07:00AM – 4:00PM) but may fluctuate slightly depending on the client's requirements.

The Associate Risk Consultant is responsible for providing support, advice and monitoring to a single (or maximum two) dedicated Control Risks ONE client(s). This position will interact with the client(s) directly and will require the candidate to provide general security support, risk monitoring, and updates proactively as well as be able to reactively respond to client queries. This position will be the primary point of contact for the requirements of the clients to ensure their needs are met by Control Risks ONE.

Role tasks and responsibilities

  • Client support and liaison: Provide expert guidance and act as a key liaison between Control Risks ONE and dedicated client in high-stress environments, managing security-related incidents and inquiries.
  • Tailored security solutions: Respond promptly to client requests, delivering bespoke verbal and written security assessments and recommendations based on a deep understanding of their operations, while ensuring proactive crisis management and coordination.
  • Intelligence and security risk consulting: Collect, evaluate, and disseminate relevant open-source and proprietary information, preparing comprehensive threat intelligence reports and risk assessments. Monitor global events and forecast operational impacts to the client based on bespoke escalation protocols and risk registers.
  • Crisis management and provider identification: Support Control Risks crisis management teams and evacuation operations by maintaining situational awareness of crises and identifying security providers to ensure rapid response and client safety.
  • Client account management: Serve as the primary point of contact for the dedicated account.

Requirements

  • Education and experience: Bachelor's degree in international relations, politics, security studies, criminal justice or a related field, OR equivalent work experience. Minimum of 2-3 years' experience in a professional environment related to threat or intelligence analysis or security industry-related. – Preferred: Previous experience working for a GSOC or in the extractive sector
  • Languages: Native or equivalent fluency in Portuguese and English; both written and spoken. Proficiency in Spanish is preferred.
  • Crisis management: Proven ability to remain calm and effective in high-stress environments.
  • Global awareness: Broad knowledge of global geopolitical affairs and the ability to assess operational impacts across various sectors and industries
  • Analytical skills: Strong aptitude for interpreting data sources, with excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Customer service excellence: Outstanding customer service skills, with a strong focus on client satisfaction.
  • Collaborative team player: Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese, with the ability to adapt communication styles to suit different audiences and cultures. Fluency in a language other than English and Portuguese is desired, but not required
  • Adaptability: Ability to be responsive to changing requirements and adaptable to unpredictable circumstances, with a demonstrated capacity to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Discretion: Ability to act discreetly and apply company policies appropriately to inform decisions and actions.

title: SDR (Sales Development Representative) BRA (Remote)
description:
A Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving revenue growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers for the company's products or services. As the first point of contact in the sales process, SDRs are responsible for creating a strong pipeline of opportunities that fuels the success of the sales team.
This role involves researching and segmenting target markets, identifying decision-makers within organizations, and using multiple outreach channels—such as cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn messaging, and social media engagement—to connect with prospects. SDRs must understand each prospect's industry, challenges, and goals to effectively tailor their pitch and communicate the value proposition of the company's offerings.
Beyond initiating contact, SDRs qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring that account executives receive prospects who are ready and able to engage in meaningful sales conversations. They also schedule discovery calls, product demos, or meetings, and document all interactions in the company's CRM system to maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline.
An effective SDR is goal-driven, resilient, and curious, able to handle rejection while staying motivated to meet or exceed key performance metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, and conversion rates. Collaboration with the marketing team is also essential, as SDRs often provide feedback on campaign performance and prospect insights to improve lead generation efforts.
Success in this role requires exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, strong active listening abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and articulate the benefits of complex products or services. SDRs who excel not only open doors for new business but also build lasting relationships that can lead to long-term customers and sustainable company growth.
By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.

title: Senior Operations Geologist
description:
* Please ensure attached resume is in English language *
The Operations Geologist ensures all wells are drilled safely, stays in sync with all regulations, and efficiently to meet defined well objectives in accordance with the Statement of Requirements (SOR) and meets all expectations of the New Wells Common Process. This delivery requires collaboration and effective communication across bp Subsurface and Wells teams. A strong HSSE attitude and commercial awareness are essential, with a focus on safe, efficient, and cost-effective practices.
Essential Experience And Job Requirements
Degree in Geology, Geophysics or Geoscience or related field
Seasoned professional of relevant industry experience, most of which should have been gained in a geological operations environment
Industry experience in the areas of well planning and operations geology, well-site geology. Working knowledge of drilling operations, pore pressure, mudlogging is desirable
Experience with formation evaluation tools (LWD/MWD, wireline logging) and basic interpretation of rock/fluid types and borehole conditions
Proficiency in monitoring drilling progress and interpreting real-time geological data.
Ability to coordinate mobilization of geological contractors and service providers.
Proficiency with geological reporting and data management tools, with experience integrating digital solutions into workflows.
Geological, seismic and petrophysical log interpretation using workstation skills is beneficial;
Strong written and verbal communication skills
The individual needs to have a collaborative team-first mentality, be self-motivated, with a strong ability to integrate across subject areas
Ability to lead the subsurface efforts in late design (D5-11) activities consistent with bp well planning process, leading the creation of the GOP prior to drilling, and the EOWR (End of Well Report) and required handover documents following TD.
In addition, it would be help if you had
Experience with Offshore Brazil exploration and development wells
Well Planning & Design
HSSE focus and ability to influence compliance standards for Safety and Operational Risks
Support well planning activities and construction of relevant NWS documents consistent with bp's Wells Common Process, WCD-SOR (Wells Concept Document, Statement of Requirements) D1-D8 Stage gates ( All process decision points are numbered D1-D11)
Assist in the creation of pre-drill risk registers and ensure mitigation and contingency plans are created for all geological risks
Ensure integration of well planning and operational activity through strong collaboration with key interested parties, NWS (New Wells Solutions) and Wells leadership
Liaise with project geologists and well engineers to define well functional specifications and casing points while defining operational success criteria and support scenario planning
Lead the construction of the GOP (Geological Operations Plan) ensuring all relevant information is contained in this document
Geological Operations
Lead the daily subsurface operations meeting with the Rig based subsurface entities (WSG, BioStrat, ML, LWD), present NDS (No Drilling Surprises), expected geology in subsurface hole section previews, and reviews
Participate in DWOP, LWOP, CWOP exercises, ensure that the speciality vendors are engaged early in the process, present material on NDS, expected geology for subsurface hole section previews, hole section reviews for the well.
Monitor real-time well data and perform geologic correlations; work closely with petrophysicists on LWD and wireline data, coring operations, and data transmission
Supervise and coordinate with the Wellsite Geologist, ensuring alignment on subsurface objectives, data quality, operational decisions and that all geological activities on the rig are properly managed.
Provide support to the wellsite geologist: daily and as needed ops call, provide up to date information and offset date, collaborate between Subsurface and Wells to ensure all well objectives are delivered safely.
Ensure efficient delivery of the data acquisition program, ensure Vendors Co-owners are delivering and receiving all required data and updates. SPA for Co-Owner communication and information dissemination.
Post Well
Support successful EOW Report completion ensuring the report meets the expectations of the New Wells Common Process
Ensure all data is finalised and electronically captures in the corporate regional data store and hard data copy is distributed accordingly to partners
Capture and document all post well key takeaways and share in appropriate NWD venues.
Support root cause analysis for any NPT event related to subsurface operations (Orange category) and ensure these findings are distributed through the appropriate venues and collaborators

title: Junior Maintenance Technician
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Your responsibilities:

  • In this position, the Service Technician will be responsible for carrying out service and maintenance tasks on turbochargers, working both at company facilities and at customer sites. In this role you will be responsible for performing service and maintenance on Turbochargers in Brazil.

  • The role provides specialized technical support, executing activities in accordance with Accelleron workflows, quality standards, and safety guidelines — ensuring superior customer experience and operational excellence.

  • Service Delivery: Performs Service tasks like disassembly, cleaning, inspection, measurement and assembly of different types of turbochargers, in accordance with work instructions, through the identification of technical problems, carrying out remote and in-person analyses at the Workshop and or in the field in various categories of vessels (ships, platforms, etc.) and thermoelectric plants. In the field it means by performing installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, updates, renovations and replacements, among others, meeting customer expectations and pre-established internal procedures.

  • Customer Approach: Contributes to customer satisfaction by executing Service work according to customer order and expectation Creates and maintains a good relationship with customers and understands their needs Identifies new sales opportunities and communicates them internally. Execute the repair according to instructions from service coordination

  • Materials & Supply: Coordinates, prepares and ensures that all materials, parts and equipment are available and at the appropriate quality for Service activities.

  • Documents & Reports: Prepares all documents and reports to be signed by the customer representative Reports work done in a timely manner and follows up when needed. Perform maintenance inspections and reports on turbochargers. Clean up parts and take pictures and measurements as requested by maintenance tool and process

  • Troubleshooting: Proactively identifies potential equipment failures and requests proactive corrective actions Troubleshoots equipment failure and makes recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future.

  • Operational Excellence Proactively identifies suggestions for product and quality improvement and communicates them further in the Accelleron organization Provides recommendations to management to improve operations and customer service.

  • Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Integrity: Applies safety rules and safe practices, environmental responsibilities as well as quality process. Reports unsafe practices and incidents.

Your background:

Education and Experience -

  • Technical training in Mechanics with an active CFT (Mechanical Technician Certificate);

  • Experience in maintenance and service of rotating machinery, engines (minimum 2 years), or preferable focus on working with turbochargers, large combustion engines, and/or mechanical technologies related to the maritime segment;

  • Preferable experience in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including the use of precision measuring instruments, hand tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools, etc;

  • Preferably certified or experienced in lifting operations, overhead crane handling, and electric forklift, work at height, ensuring compliance with industrial safety standards;

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Planner etc.);

  • Intermediate English;

  • Availability for national and international travel to execute services and training;

  • Active driver's license

  • Passport.

Core Competencies -

  • Familiarity in working within regulations and rules, following management guidelines;

  • Service and solution-oriented mindset, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills;

  • Customer and results orientation

  • Responsibility, autonomy, and commitment to safety

  • Effective communication and teamwork.

  • Proven capability to perform well under emergency work demand.

  • Proactivity and continuous improvement mindset.

Job Conditions -

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

  • Modality: Workshop and Field (customer site) activities. Weekly adapted based on the customer's demand

  • Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours

  • Available to travel: Required across Brazil neighboring countries (Uruguay, Paraguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Argentina)

title: Network Solution Architect
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own  aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.
Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.
Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement
Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO
POR QUE TRABALHAR NA TLP?
Na TLP, acreditamos que a conexão que transforma começa pelas pessoas. Aqui, cada talento é valorizado, e todos têm espaço para crescer, inovar e fazer a diferença. Nosso propósito é conectar pessoas e encurtar distâncias, e isso começa dentro de casa: com um ambiente colaborativo, oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e o respeito à diversidade.
Conecte-se com o futuro. Conecte-se com a TLP
DIVERSIDADE E INCLUSÃO
Valorizamos quem você é e acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossas equipes e impulsiona a inovação. Por isso, construímos um espaço genuinamente inclusivo onde cada pessoa é bem-vinda e tem oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento. Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD), talentos de todos os perfis e identidades — aqui, cada diferença soma e cada pessoa importa.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
Analisar propostas comerciais e contratos sob a ótica de precificação, margem, custos diretos e indiretos, impostos e riscos;
Desenvolver modelos de precificação para novos negócios, considerando diferentes cenários e estruturas contratuais;

title: Gerente de Supply Chain
description:
Sobre nosso cliente
A Grit Executive Search está recrutando um Gerente de Supply Chain para uma empresa que é líder no seu segmento. Nosso cliente vem passando por forte expansão nacional além de desenvolvimento de novos produtos e mercados.
Missão da posição
Estruturar e integrar a cadeia de suprimentos (insumos, compras, planejamento, estoque e logística), criando previsibilidade operacional e eficiência para suportar a expansão B2B, com redução de desperdícios e melhoria do fluxo entre vendas e produção.
Principais responsabilidades
Estruturar o fluxo ponta a ponta entre Comercial, Produção, Compras e Logística.
Implantar rotina de planejamento de demanda e abastecimento (base S&OP).
Organizar política de compras e gestão de fornecedores (prazos, qualidade, custo e risco).
Mapear e reduzir desperdícios de matéria-prima e retrabalhos.
Dar visibilidade e governança para estoque/inventário e consumo de materiais.
Melhorar nível de serviço logístico (prazo de entrega, instalação e manutenção).
Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais (OTIF, lead time, perdas, acuracidade de estoque, ruptura, custo logístico).
Conduzir melhorias de processo com abordagem Lean/Kanban (ou equivalentes).
Atuar em gestão transversal da operação existente (incluindo interface com liderança de produção atual).
Preparar base de estrutura para futura evolução de equipe e maturidade industrial.
Apoiar padronização de operação entre unidade RJ e, progressivamente, Recife.
Realizar visitas e viagens conforme necessidade de operação/projetos.
Desafios críticos da cadeira (transparência com candidatos)
Entrada em ambiente de transformação com processos ainda pouco estruturados.
Necessidade de influenciar áreas sem time próprio dedicado no primeiro momento.
Gestão de mudanças em contexto de resistência de parte da operação.
Crescimento com pressão de prazo e sazonalidade por projetos governamentais.
Requisitos obrigatórios
Formação em Engenharia de Produção ou Engenharia Mecânica.
Experiência consistente em ambiente fabril, com foco em processos e supply.
Vivência prática em compras, planejamento, estoque e logística industrial.
Histórico de implantação/organização de processos em operação de baixa ou média maturidade.
Capacidade de atuar com gestão por indicadores e rotina operacional.
Disponibilidade para viagens.
Diferenciais desejáveis
Experiência com processos de solda, montagem e materiais como inox/alumínio.
Vivência com operações industriais com customização/projeto sob demanda.
Experiência com múltiplas unidades (ex.: matriz + filial regional).
Conhecimento aplicado em Lean, Kanban ou melhoria contínua.
Competências comportamentais
Mão na massa com visão sistêmica.
Influência sem depender de hierarquia formal.
Comunicação objetiva com perfis técnicos e executivos.
Resiliência e pragmatismo em ambiente de mudança.
Organização, disciplina de execução e senso de prioridade.
Local de atuação
Base principal: Rio de Janeiro (Bom Sucesso)
Interface futura com unidade de Recife.

title: Consultor(a) FI/CO Sênior
description:
A NEORIS, agora parte da EPAM, é uma Aceleradora Digital que ajuda empresas a darem o próximo passo em direção ao futuro. Temos mais de 20 anos de experiência como parceiros digitais de algumas das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos mais de 4.000 profissionais em 11 países, com uma cultura multicultural e de startup, na qual cultivamos a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo para criar soluções de alto valor para nossos clientes. 
  
Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas oportunidades estão abertas para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, raça, idade, identidade, orientação ou condição.

Localidade: Rio de Janeiro

Modelo de atuação: Presencial

Formato de contratação: CLT + Benefícios

Descrição do Cargo
Estamos em busca de um/uma Consultor(a) SAP FI/CO Sênior com ampla experiência em projetos de implementação, suporte e evolução de soluções SAP nas áreas de Finanças, Controladoria e Contabilidade. Procuramos um profissional com visão de negócio, domínio técnico dos módulos FI e CO, capacidade de liderança técnica e habilidade para atuar diretamente com áreas funcionais e usuários-chave.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como consultor funcional SAP nos módulos FI (com foco em AP/AR);
  • Levantar requisitos com áreas de negócio e propor soluções aderentes às melhores práticas SAP;
  • Configurar e manter os módulos SAP FI/CO conforme necessidades do negócio;
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para integrações e melhorias;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente projetos de rollout, migração, upgrade de versão e melhorias evolutivas;
  • Suportar atividades de testes integrados, validação e homologação;
  • Realizar treinamentos e capacitação de usuários-chave e finais;
  • Atuar em projetos regulatórios e fiscais, apoiando áreas contábil e tributária;
  • Interagir com equipes técnicas, funcionais e gerenciais de forma clara e produtiva.

Requisitos

  • Experiência  como Consultor SAP FI/CO;
  • Experiência comprovada com implementação, sustentação e melhorias nos módulos FI/CO;
  • Conhecimentos em processos regulatórios e projetos voltados para ANEEL (desejável).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA;
  • Atuação prévia em empresas de energia, saneamento ou serviços públicos;
  • Participação em projetos de revisão tarifária ou regulamentação contábil/fiscal;

Oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação: Benefícios mensais para suas despesas com alimentação, dentro e fora de casa. 
  • Previdência Privada: Planejamento de futuro com contribuição complementar à aposentadoria. 
  • Plano de Saúde: Cobertura médica de alta qualidade para você e seu dependente legal. 
  • Plano Odontológico: Cuidados odontológicos completos, com ampla rede de atendimento. 
  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção e segurança para você e seus entes queridos. 
  • Aulas de Inglês/Espanhol: Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas. 
  • Wellhub: Benefícios e descontos em academias e programas de bem-estar. 
  • Auxílio Creche: Suporte financeiro para despesas com educação infantil. 
  • Neoris Global Campus: Plataforma de desenvolvimento com oportunidades contínuas de aprendizado e crescimento profissional.

title: Colhedor Lafe Zona Sul RJ
description:
Detalhes da vaga
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:
Esta pessoa irá atuar no atendimento, realizando a coleta de materiais biológicos para a marca LAFE. O nosso foco está na excelência do atendimento e segurança nos procedimentos dos pacientes.
Nosso propósito é cuidar das pessoas e levar saúde para a sociedade. Somos reconhecidos por isso, e temos uma marca de valor, sabemos que confiam em nosso trabalho.
Se você se sente feliz em receber sorrisos diários e realizar um trabalho que transforma vidas, essa vaga é para você
Sobre a Área
Realizar coletas de sangue e outros tipos de materiais biológicos de acordo com pedido médico, solicitação do cliente ou orientação da liderança imediata. As coletas serão realizadas de modo customizado a necessidade do cliente, em domicilio ou demais locais pertinentes a necessidade, desde que com condições necessárias para a garantia da biossegurança no atendimento.
Principais Atividades
Realizar coleta de sangue ou materiais;
Controlar a temperatura dos equipamentos e gerir a solicitação de guias e materiais necessários para atendimento;
Fazer gestão da agenda conforme atualização da demanda diária;
Controlar estoque e solicitar requisição de material em tempo hábil de reposição;
Realizar conferencia de guia, cadastro via App Domiclio;
Recebimento de valores;
Identificação de amostras, Acondicionamento e transporte de amostras biológicas coletadas, entrega de material para distribuição em base de atendimento IHP, acerto diário de rotina.
Buscamos Alguém Que Apresente
Técnico de Patologia Clínica/ Análises Clínicas
Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.
Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:
Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.
Informações Da Vaga
Modelo de Trabalho: PRESENCIAL
Carga Horária: 180h
Escala: Segunda a Sábado
Horário de Trabalho: 06h30 as 13h30
LOCAL:ZONA SUL
Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada
Saúde e Bem-estar
Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.
Proteção e Estabilidade
Previdência privada;
Participação nos lucros;
Seguro de vida.
Facilidades Para o Dia a Dia
Vale-Alimentação;
Vale-Refeição;
Auxílio-Creche;
Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.
Desenvolvimento e Educação
Plataforma de ensino;
Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.
Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.
Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.
Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

title: Engenheiro de processos de instrumentação sênior
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições 

  1. Atuar como referência técnica de engenharia para o time de projetistas da disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  2. Elaborar, Verificar e Aprovar documentos técnicos de engenharia da disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  3. Elaborar, Verificar e Aprovar estudos técnicos de engenharia da disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  4. Elaborar, Verificar e Aprovar o planejamento, listagem e a quantificação de documentos elaborados pela disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  5. Elaborar e revisar os procedimentos e padronizações dos documentos de projeto 3D e 2D da disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  6. Apoiar tecnicamente as demais áreas/setores na disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  7. Analisar impacto na implementação dos projetos de engenharia nas rotinas operacionais das plantas de produção de petróleo, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  8. Participar de todas as etapas de projetos de engenharia desde a concepção da solução, projeto básico, projeto de detalhamento, implementação e AS-BUILT no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  9. Coordenar ou auxiliar na coordenação de todas as etapas dos projetos de engenharia uni ou multidisciplinares garantindo os prazos, qualidade e exequibilidade dos projetos;
  10. Apoiar tecnicamente o escritório de projetos (PMO) na elaboração de cronogramas de projeto e nas demais atribuições do PMO, no tocante as atividades de coordenador uni ou multidisciplinar de projetos, bem como na disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  11. Emitir pareceres definindo as prioridades, prazos, planejamento e alocação de recursos dos projetos, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  12. Efetuar e emitir relatórios de visitas técnicas a fornecedores, contratadas, parceiros e unidades de produção de petróleo quando solicitado, no tocante a atuação da disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica;
  13. Participar de Grupos de Trabalhos, Comissões, Auditorias, Fiscalizações, Audiências e Reuniões quando solicitado;
  14. Emitir, Aprovar e Verificar documentos técnicos de engenharia aplicáveis a etapa de comissionamento de projetos, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  15. Acompanhar e prestar apoio técnico no escritório, no site de fornecedores e nas áreas operacionais durante as etapas de implementação e comissionamento de projetos, no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  16. Apoiar tecnicamente os setores de suprimentos e de suas contratadas, na prospecção de fornecedores, seleção, especificação e pareceres técnicos de materiais/equipamentos no tocante a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  17. Atuar na prospecção de novos fornecedores, novos equipamentos e novas tecnologias aplicáveis a disciplina de Instrumentação e Elétrica, em conformidade com as Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos nacionais e internacionais, aplicáveis aos projetos de engenharia de plantas de produção de petróleo offshore;
  18. Planejar tanto a gestão quanto a execução do comissionamento, com envolvimento de todas as áreas que tenham interface com a atividade (Operação, Contratadas, Manutenção, SMS e outras), sendo necessário para isso definir e detalhar os elementos técnicos principais, a linha de base do cronograma, a organização e os meios para a execução do processo de comissionamento;
  19. Disponibilizar toda documentação referente a recebimento, montagem e condicionamento e dos meios físicos necessários para a execução da fase seguinte do comissionamento (Pré-operação e Partida);
  20. Identificar os equipamentos sujeitos à Testes de Aceitação em Fábrica (TAF), suas condições de acompanhamento e colaboradores responsáveis pelo acompanhamento dos respectivos testes;
  21. Acompanhar montagem, limpeza, inspeção e instalação de equipamentos e instrumentos;
  22. Comprovação do atendimento às normas regulamentadoras;
  23. Identificação e registro de pendências não impeditivas;
  24. Aplicação de Listas de Verificação (LVs) ou Folhas de Verificação de Itens (FVIs);
  25. Promover permanentemente a análise dos projetos de modo a proporcionar um grau de facilidade de construção.

Requisitos e Qualificações 

  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Engenharia.
  • Experiência: Experiência em projetos de Instrumentação ou Elétrica para a indústria de petróleo e unidades de produção offshore.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Proficiente em ferramentas Microsoft Office, Microsoft TEAMS, Power BI, SAP S/4HANA, Autodesk Navisworks Manage, Autodesk AutoCAD, Intergraph SmartPlant Foundation, Intergraph Smart 3D e Intergraph Smart Review, Smart Instrumentation, Smart Electrical. SKM Power Tools. Inglês no nível de proficiência capaz de efetuar leitura, compreensão e fala para execução das atividades a seguir: Relacionamento com fornecedores, contratadas e parceiros; Treinamentos/Cursos; Utilização de softwares; Intepretação e aplicação de Normas, Diretrizes, Padrões e Procedimentos. Desejável experiência em construtibilidade na construção e montagem de projetos.

  2. Testes
  3. Entrevista com RH
  4. Validação de Requisitos

Bem-vindo(a) ao mundo Infotec

Somos a Infotec Brasil, uma empresa referência nacional em terceirização de serviços, processos (BPO) e pessoas. Em 2025, celebramos 40 anos de trajetória, atuando com excelência nos setores de Óleo e Gás, Energia, Mineração e Siderurgia.

title: Sales Operations Assistant
description:
Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just three years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 140 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.

Our Impact

While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4,000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.


Check us out here: Decentralized Masters

What will you be doing?

We're hiring a Sales Operations Assistant to execute and maintain the operational foundation of our sales systems inside HubSpot.

You will work inside the CRM daily to ensure data accuracy, lead routing integrity, workflow reliability, and pipeline hygiene.

This is a highly detail-oriented execution role. You will not design revenue strategy — you will ensure it runs flawlessly.

Key ResponsibilitiesCRM & Pipeline Integrity
  • Maintain accurate deal stages, ownership, and required properties
  • Ensure every active deal has a defined next step
  • Identify and merge duplicate records
  • Audit pipelines for stale or mis-staged deals
HubSpot Execution
  • Maintain workflows and automation under Specialist direction
  • Manage sequences and enrollment logic
  • Maintain lists and segmentation accuracy
  • Validate lead routing rules
  • QA workflow triggers and task creation
  • Update properties and lifecycle stages
Lead Flow & SLA Monitoring
  • Ensure new leads are assigned within defined SLA
  • Flag unworked or unreachable leads
  • Monitor speed-to-lead and follow-up consistency
  • Escalate anomalies immediately
Reporting & KPI Support
  • Maintain daily and weekly KPI sheets
  • Validate CRM data feeding dashboards
  • Flag anomalies in DPL, show rate, and pipeline movement
What Great Looks Like
  • Zero unassigned leads
  • <1% duplicate rate
  • <2% missing required deal properties
  • No silent workflow failures
  • Accurate reporting delivered on time
What do you bring?
  • 2–4+ years in Sales Ops, CRM administration, or sales support
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience (required)
  • Experience working with workflows, sequences, and segmentation
  • Strong process discipline and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-first culture with a globally distributed team.
  • Opportunity to own the organic growth engine of a fast-scaling DeFi brand.
  • Access to cutting-edge tools, data, and creative freedom to innovate.
  • A values-driven company culture that rewards results, autonomy, and excellence.
This Role Is Ideal For

Someone who:

  • Loves systems and clean data
  • Notices errors others miss
  • Prefers operational precision over sales strategy
  • Wants to grow into a Sales Ops Specialist role

If you are ready to take on a challenge that will shape the future of crypto finance and grow with a team of innovators, we want to hear from you

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - Fintech Airlines - Americas (Brazil - 100  Remote)
description:
About The Job
The Fintech team is the engine behind Hopper's most innovative and high-margin products, such as
Cancel for Any Reason
and
Disruption Assistance
. We are responsible for designing, building, and scaling the backend systems that power these proprietary fintech offerings, integrating them with some of the world's largest travel companies (airlines, banks, hotels) through our B2B platform,
HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions)
.

This role is at the center of Hopper's B2B strategy, building highly available, globally-scaled systems that provide peace of mind to millions of travelers on our partners' platforms and drive significant revenue for the company.

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join us in building the future of travel fintech for our HTS APAC and Enterprise airline partners.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Iterate on features in an agile manner using Scala and React (no prior experience required) and technologies like GCP, OpenAPI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub among others.
  • Decide how to best build core systems in the context of our microservices architecture
  • Ship your first code in days, iterating on features in an agile manner
  • Collaborate with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving feedback for growth
  • Execute on big opportunities, helping Hopper rise to the top of the travel industry

An ideal candidate has

  • The ability to bring leading industry techniques and technologies to the table
  • A strong understanding of distributed systems and how architectural decisions affect performance and maintainability
  • Excelled in cross-functional teams, working fluidly with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Frontend Engineers, and other highly skilled specialists
  • A passionate focus on quality, writing testable code that performs and scales
  • The ability to work with minimal guidance, be proactive and to handle uncertainty, ambiguity and the challenge of quickly evolving goals
  • Prior cloud experience
  • Working with Scala and/or React and its libraries
  • Prior airline/travel industry or eCommerce experience
  • Experience in UX design, using tools like Figma

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS' channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

title: Recruiter BRA
description:
A Recruiter is responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to meet an organization's staffing needs, ensuring that each hire aligns with both the technical requirements and the cultural values of the company. This role involves proactively sourcing candidates through a variety of channels, including job boards, professional networks, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, industry events, and employee referrals.
Once potential candidates are identified, the Recruiter screens applications, conducts initial assessments, and manages interview processes to evaluate skills, experience, and fit. They work closely with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling job descriptions, and establish selection criteria that lead to strong matches.
The role extends beyond simply filling positions—it also involves managing the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial contact to offer negotiation and onboarding. This includes coordinating interviews, providing feedback to candidates, ensuring timely communication, and guiding both candidates and hiring teams through each stage of the process. A strong focus on candidate experience is key, as positive interactions contribute to the employer's brand and long-term talent pipeline.
In many cases, Recruiters also track and analyze hiring metrics—such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness—to refine strategies and improve overall recruitment efficiency. They stay informed about labor market trends, competitive compensation data, and evolving recruitment technologies, adapting approaches to remain competitive in attracting top talent.
To excel, a Recruiter must combine exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with strategic thinking, organization, and relationship-building capabilities. Their work plays a critical role in shaping the company's workforce, influencing its ability to grow, innovate, and succeed.
By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.

title: Mecanico de Refrigeração
description:
O Mecânico de Refrigeração é responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização, como ar-condicionado, câmaras frigoríficas, freezers e outros equipamentos similares. Este profissional assegura o funcionamento eficiente e seguro dos sistemas de refrigeração, realizando diagnósticos, trocas de componentes e ajustes técnicos necessários para manter os ambientes adequadamente refrigerados. Principais Responsabilidades:Realizar a instalação de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado em ambientes comerciais, industriais e residenciais, seguindo as normas técnicas e de segurança. Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em equipamentos de refrigeração, identificando problemas, realizando ajustes, substituição de peças e limpeza de componentes para garantir o desempenho ideal. Inspecionar sistemas de refrigeração para detectar falhas, vazamentos de gás, problemas elétricos e mecânicos, utilizando ferramentas específicas para diagnósticos precisos. Realizar reparos em compressores, condensadores, evaporadores, válvulas de expansão e demais componentes dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo a restauração completa do equipamento. Realizar a carga e recarga de gás refrigerante nos sistemas, conforme as especificações técnicas e normas ambientais. Testar e ajustar os equipamentos após a instalação ou reparo, verificando a temperatura, pressão, fluxo de ar e outros parâmetros para assegurar o funcionamento correto. Preencher relatórios de serviços realizados, registrando as atividades de manutenção, peças substituídas e recomendações para futuras intervenções. title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Assistant Maintenance Supervisor

    • Background


  • The Maintenance Technician will exhibit a high standard of safety behaviors while carrying out Engine Room maintenance and Engine Room system operation. They may be expected to perform maintenance, preservation, welding, machining, pipe and mechanical fitting and related activities. Depending on its qualifications, they act as Junior Watchkeeper.

    • Authority


  • The Maintenance Operator acts under the Authority of the Assistant Maintenance Supervisor and/or Engine Room Supervisor as appropriate.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Fitters designated as part of team, visitors, vendor technicians, and sub-contractors

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Operate Engine Room Equipment and Systems and Utilities Operation
  • 1 Prepare marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems for start-up.
  • 2 Start and monitor marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems.
  • 3 Prepare and shutdown marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems.
  • 4 Follow operational and safety procedures in all aspects of work.
  • 2) Perform Maintenance activities
  • 1 Isolate and reinstate marine Engine Room or Aft Machinery Space and Utility Systems for Maintenance.
  • 2 Perform scheduled and unplanned maintenance safely and effectively under PTW Risk Assessment and Management System procedures.
  • 3 Ensure work is correctly and accurately identified, recorded and communicated.
  • 4 Perform general maintenance, greasing, cleaning, filter changing and housekeeping.
  • 5 The Maintenance operator may be required to correctly operate a Lathe, Milling and Shaping Machines, Gas Arc and or Plasma cutting.
  • 6 Maintain all portable power tools to limit of responsibility. (No; electrical' work unless accredited by the electrical department).
  • 3) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Ensure that any controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits.
  • 2 Identify and halt any unplanned (gas or liquid discharges where possible, and reported immediately according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 3 Deal with equipment, waste or other materials for disposal according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Do not waste resources such as PPE, stock items, materials, tools or spare parts.
  • 4) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Handover Offshore - Bunkering Offshore - Operating Engine Room Equipment Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Global Enterprise Management System Offshore - Safety Management Offshore - Low Level Maintenance Offshore - Condition Monitoring Offshore - Watchkeeping

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Experience in shipping as a watch keeping Engine Room rating, STCW Reg. AIII/4, or EOOW STCW Reg. AIII/1 ORor
  • General maintenance skills including fitting, and Coded Welding qualification.
  • VLCC /Large Seagoing Vessel Engine Room or FPSO operations experience desirable.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of A1 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

    • GENERAL INFORMATION

    SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

    SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.  All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Atendente comercial
description:

​Descrição da Empresa:
A Pedaço de Céu Foto Pet é um estúdio especializado em fotografia pet e família multiespécie, criado para transformar vínculos reais em memórias que atravessam o tempo.
Acreditamos que cada pet tem uma essência única e que o amor entre tutores e seus companheiros merece ser registrado com sensibilidade, calma e respeito.
Nosso trabalho vai além de "fotos bonitas": entregamos uma experiência afetiva, conduzida com acolhimento e um olhar atento aos detalhes, ao comportamento e ao conforto do animal.
Cada ensaio é planejado de forma personalizada, para que o resultado traduza verdade, conexão e história.
Objetivo da função
Ser a pessoa responsável por converter leads em sessões agendadas, com atendimento rápido, consultivo e com follow-up consistente, fazendo prospecção ativa com a base de clientes recorrentes.
Principais responsabilidades
Atender leads via WhatsApp/Instagram/Telefone com rapidez e clareza.
Fazer qualificação (perfil do tutor, tipo de pet, objetivo, disponibilidade, urgência).
Apresentar pacotes/condições e conduzir a negociação até o fechamento.
Agendar sessões e coordenar agenda com a equipe desde o início até a entrega final das fotos.
Registrar tudo em CRM/planilha (etapa do lead, motivo de perda, status do pagamento).
Fazer follow-up diário dos leads abertos.
Garantir o básico do pós-venda: confirmação de sessão, checklist do cliente, alinhamento de expectativas.
Sinalizar gargalos para o marketing (objeções recorrentes, etapas que travam conversão).
Indicadores de sucesso (KPIs)
Tempo de primeira resposta: meta de 5 minutos em horário comercial.
Taxa de conversão Lead → Agendamento/Fechamento: meta de 15%
Follow-up diário: 90% de leads sem ficar "parado".
Organização do funil: 100% dos leads com etapa definida e motivo de perda registrado.
Requisitos (obrigatórios)
Experiência com atendimento comercial (WhatsApp/DM) e fechamento.
Escrita objetiva e profissional (sem enrolação, sem "texto pronto genérico").
Organização para trabalhar com funil, agenda e rotina de follow-up.
Conforto com metas e remuneração variável.
Equipamento e internet para trabalho (nos dias remotos).
Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)
Experiência com negócios de serviço/agenda (estética, saúde, fotografia, eventos).
Experiência com CRM (Canva, Notion, Trello, etc.).
Remuneração (PJ)
Fixo mensal: R$ 1.800,00
Comissão por meta de faturamento
Processo seletivo
Triagem pelo LinkedIn
Conversa rápida (15–20 min)
Teste prático simples (organização de funil + simulação de atendimento)
Entrevista final com sócios
Como se candidatar
Enviar (currículo/LinkedIn) + uma mensagem curta respondendo:
Qual sua experiência com atendimento e vendas por WhatsApp?
Qual resultado/indicador você já bateu em função comercial?

title: Commercial Coordinator
description:
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Commercial and Retail

Regular

Experienced Professionals

Job Description:

What's the role

The position holder is responsible for securing mandate, preparing and leading negotiations of upstream commercial agreements with counterparties. These include petroleum contracts for unitizations, equalizations, Joint Operating Agreements, infrastructure agreements, gas sales and transport agreements, etc. The holder also acts as the Client Lead for a designated Asset Commercial Venture Manager. The Client Lead role ensures the delivery of contract negotiation plans meet the Venture manager expectations.

The position reports to the Commercial Contracts and Agreements Manager, and it is member of this pool of resources that are responsible for delivering a set of specifically assigned contract negotiations. It is a strong opportunity for the individual to build a deep knowledge across the full breadth of petroleum agreements. Other peers whose inputs may be required and need to be coordinated include: (i) Technical staff in key areas for the specific agreement, (ii) Advisors in key functions supporting negotiations including legal, finance, tax, economics and regulatory.

What you'll be doing

  • Negotiate commercial agreements, such as JOAs, JBAs, Unitization Agreements, etc.

  • Effectively represent Shell´s interests during contract negotiations

  • Act as the Client Lead for coordination of all negotiations within the scope of a designated Venture Manager to ensure priorities and expectations are agreed and met.  Update negotiation plans and action logs

  • Prepare and manage proposals for commencing negotiations, mandates, investment proposals and the approval processes required for agreement signature

  • Support on project strategy, including strategic framing support, risk reviews, etc.

  • Manage stakeholder interactions, identify specific challenges or alternatives, propose clear recommendations for action and secure internal functional support to implement

  • Ensure agreements are aligned with industry practice and in compliance with Shell standards and policies.

  • Coordinate the functional support required to deliver the agreements including legal, finance, tax, etc.

  • Regular progress reporting to Venture Manager. Interaction with other Venture Managers, commercial leads and General Manager

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than the current employer

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or Engineering fields

  • Minimum of 6 years' experience in a related field

  • Experience of identifying and evaluating risk-reward balance in commercial contracts to create and protect value

  • Experience in working with multiple stakeholders, partnership environment involving complex governance

  • Knowledge of Upstream commercial petroleum contract types and regimes is desired

  • Experience in negotiating and drafting agreements

  • Ability to analyze economic and financial valuations to determine preferred deal outcomes and strong logical reasoning and problem-solving skills

  • Capacity to quickly process long complex agreements and their interactions with high attention to detail

  • High level of communication skills for negotiation enquiry, advocacy and internal consultation and reporting

  • Fluency in written and spoken English to be able to draft and review mandate and internal approval documents

  • High level of motivation, diligence, perseverance and emotional resilience

  • Ability to prioritize own and other deal team staff work, work effectively under stress and to manage time pressure that may occur resulting from partner/stakeholder demands or as a consequence of negotiating tactics

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You'll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You'll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.

  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.

  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.

  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.

  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.

  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.

  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.

  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.

  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.

  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world's most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here .

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell's strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net-zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.
